# Draftava 1.3.7
- Makes switching between projects safer by saving only when there are real pending edits and refusing to leave a project when that save fails. - Improves reopening cloud-backed projects with coordinated reads and clearer handling of temporarily unavailable files. - Protects newer project data by refusing to open or save an older cloud workspace generation when newer retained Draftava History exists. - Prevents persistence state and delayed filesystem callbacks from leaking across project switches.
